# Baby Docs: Newborn Paperwork

> Baby Docs is a newborn paperwork checklist app for iPhone: birth certificate, Social Security card, health plan and leave, with deadlines and official links.

## App

- [Baby Docs: Newborn Paperwork Checklist for iPhone](https://jackwallner.com/ios/babydocs/index.html.md): Baby Docs is a newborn paperwork checklist app for iPhone: birth certificate, Social Security card, health plan and leave, with deadlines and official links.

## Guides

- [Newborn Paperwork Checklist: Certificate, SSN, Insurance](https://jackwallner.com/ios/babydocs/newborn-paperwork-checklist.html.md): A US newborn paperwork checklist: birth certificate, Social Security number and card, and health insurance deadlines (30 days job-based, 60 days Marketplace).
